recovered_spatial_step.scope: Evaluate original mapped contact forces with centered stencil coordinates and direct increments.

independent_spatial_step_audit.scope: Independently assemble centered contact, body inertia and jaw PD balances for a recovered state.
independent_spatial_step_audit.limitations: This reconstructs the recovered physical step without importing or calling the precision-aware coupled solver. Contact arithmetic, original consistent mass/armature, PD/caps/passive damping and unchanged force budgets are explicit. Full remaining history, independent old-state arithmetic comparisons and spatial/contact/geometry convergence remain required.

original80_field_audit.scope: Audit every original-history global stress bound and prepare objective resolved-load replays.
original80_field_audit.limitations: Every saved physical state keeps its global unaveraged nonlinear peak interval and reference hotspot position. Whole-volume Bernstein determinant/numerator bounds use saved wide coordinates; rounded FP64 field bounds and corner rounding differences are separate diagnostics. Computed-field bounds do not measure continuum error. Linear replay uses a consistent-mass fitted material frame; full-inertia versus rigid-relief differences are declared model diagnostics, not native numerical errors or matched rigid/deformable feedback. Only the audited source history is covered. Physical spatial/contact/geometry/time convergence, remaining finite-footprint models and verified warmed costs remain required.

actual_native_cuda_replays.scope: Replay independently audited original-history loads through native Quadrants recovery.
actual_native_cuda_replays.limitations: This checks the actual native production solve on objective resolved nodal loads at explicit original-history times. Full-inertia and rigid-relief inputs are separate declared problems. It does not establish finite-footprint load-model accuracy, matching rigid/deformable feedback, physical spatial/contact/time convergence or a verified warmed accuracy/cost range.

independent_interior_checks.scope: Check wide whole-volume certificates against independent interior barycentric stress samples.
independent_interior_checks.limitations: Barycentric samples independently check the stored Bernstein certificates; sampling alone is not a whole-volume maximum proof. The certificate follows the affine-F determinant and quadratic deviatoric Kirchhoff Bernstein construction. The explicit long-double stress cancellation allowance is recorded separately. This validates computed fields, not continuum/contact accuracy or complete application history.
